title: Unicon submission
description: submission.json at the root of a submission commit, for a task on a run workflow. A submit writes one commit to the entrant's submission repo, as the entrant: the files of every file and folder input under files/<input id>/, and this file naming them. An entrant input given once is its files or its value, and one inside the task's repeat is given per part, the position of its tuple from 1, its files under files/<input id>/<part>/; a run whose part is not given is skipped.

schema_version.description: The submission shape this file is written against.

inputs.description: One entry per entrant input the plan declares, keyed by the input id.

run_input.description: An entrant input given once, its files or its value, or one inside the task's repeat, given per part.

parts.description: An entrant input inside the task's repeat: one entry per part given, keyed by the position of its tuple from 1, so a label never shows a file's name. A part left out is not given, and every run made from its tuple is skipped.

files.description: A file or folder input: its files in the commit. A file input carries exactly one; a folder input one or more, at their paths in the folder; a part its files at files/<input id>/<part>/<relative path>.
Paths from the root of the commit, files/<input id>/<relative path>.

value.description: A text, number, boolean or enum input, as the entrant gave it or as its default.
